study_identification_part.si_4_title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: B-spline Bayesian linear regression for regional GMV normative modeling.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Brie /uniFB02 y, for each brain region, we estimated an age-related normative model with datasets II and III ( n = 510 1 229 = 739) (Figure 1B, top) to predict regional GMV as a function of age and sex plus nuisance covariate TIV using a B-spline Bayesian linear regression (37).

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Gray matter volume (GMV) of each brain region (AAL atlas).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: After all T1 images were preprocessed, the GMV of each brain region was estimated based on the Automated Anatomical Labeling atlas, and the total intracranial volume (TIV) for each participant was calculated simultaneously.
